purpose: Project-agnostic executable Product acceptance and selective repair routing.
separation_rule: The answer describes the observed result. The lifecycle describes whether that result is current and usable. Invalidation changes lifecycle without rewriting the historical answer.

policy_amendment_invalidation.rule: A content-addressed policy amendment supplies the exact invalidated question IDs. Only those questions and their dependent children become INVALIDATED; unrelated verified answers are reused.

question_rules: Every question is one observable yes-or-no proposition.
Every question ends with a question mark.
Every answer binds the exact evidence, commit, worktree, build, environment, observation time, and question-tree version.
Applicability is evaluated independently for every selected question.
A root with no selected questions carries one compact non-applicability proof.
Confidence scores, weighted aggregates, mostly-compliant states, and self-attested acceptance are forbidden.

forbidden: one narrative non-applicability answer per irrelevant question
re-emitting unchanged answers as new events

INVALIDATED.rule: Any prior answer may be retained with INVALIDATED lifecycle until a new current observation is recorded. It cannot contribute to PASS.

owner_boundary_contract.rule: True owner boundaries are a separate blocker object, never a fourth Product root or a replacement answer.
owner_boundary_contract.scope: Pause only the affected outcome; continue unrelated work.

evidence_cache.reuse_rule: Reuse only when the answer is VERIFIED, the question-tree version and exact relevant hashes match, the environment contract permits reuse, and selective invalidation did not touch the question.

invalidation.rule: A repair invalidates only the changed question and dependent descendants. Unaffected verified answers remain reusable.

critical_freeze.rule: A critical finding freezes only affected surfaces unless exact evidence proves global impact. Unaffected work continues.
